FINAL_SHOT_COMMITMENT: This is the LAST attempt at a SOTA-beating method claim. e9 (single fact) and e10 (pseudo-scarcity) both went to Mem0. This run fixes the two diagnosed flaws with pre-stated reasons (representation efficiency; no true scarcity). If ledger_measured does not beat mem0 here, we STOP hunting regimes (further search = p-hacking) and pivot the paper to characterization + provisioning-law (Method B), reporting all three losses honestly.
experiment: TRUE-SCARCITY FINAL SHOWDOWN. e10 loss diagnosis: (1) our verbatim-sentence slots cost ~5 words/fact vs Mem0's ~2-word key:value entries -> representation inefficiency, licensed to fix by e8b (budget-EXEMPTION is the lever, verbatim copy NOT required -> exempt region can be compact key:value); (2) at M=12,B=25 Mem0 fits ALL facts (12x2=24<=25) -> no scarcity, allocation never mattered. Fix: M=28 >> B/2 -> every method must drop most facts; WHICH facts is now the whole game.
design: Sonnet, temp=0. C=10 chains x M=28 facts (7/type), K=4 hops, per-hop budget B=25 words, ledger capacity P=10 entries (~2 words each, notes get max(5, B-2P)=5). Arms: free_text (naive) / mem0 (faithful extract+merge, SOTA salience) / ledger_folk (compact exempt ledger, entries chosen numbers-first = folk control) / ledger_measured (entries chosen by leave-one-chain-out measured per-type free_text survival, most fragile first) [OURS]. ledger_folk isolates allocation from representation.
arithmetic_prediction: Using e10-measured floors (numeric 0, preference 0, entity .567, negation .5): measured protects pref(7)+num(3) -> unprotected 4num*0 + 7ent*.567 + 7neg*.5 = 7.5 -> total ~(10+7.5)/28 = .62. folk protects num(7)+ent(3) -> unprotected 7pref*0 + 4ent*.567 + 7neg*.5 = 5.8 -> ~.56. mem0 fits ~12 of 28 salient facts -> ~.45-.60 depending which it drops (it is fragility-blind; if it drops preferences, its total falls toward .5). Predicted ordering: ledger_measured > ledger_folk ~ mem0 >> free_text, with measured-mem0 ~ +0.05..+0.15 and measured-folk ~ +0.05.

PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.BEATS_SOTA: ledger_measured > mem0 AND ledger_measured > ledger_folk. -> the win decomposes: compact budget-exempt representation achieves parity, measurement-driven allocation adds the edge Mem0's fragility-blind salience cannot. Honest SOTA-beating method claim, scoped to true scarcity.
PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.REPRESENTATION_ONLY: ledger_measured ~ ledger_folk and both > mem0 -> compact exemption beats Mem0 but measurement adds nothing over folk here -> method claim reduces to the representation; measurement-necessity rests on e7 (vs naive baselines) only.
PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.ALLOCATION_ONLY: ledger_measured > ledger_folk but ledger_measured <= mem0 -> measurement helps within our representation but the representation still loses to Mem0's pipeline -> no SOTA claim; allocation finding folded into characterization.
PRE_REGISTERED_READOUT.SOTA_WINS_AGAIN: mem0 >= ledger_measured and >= ledger_folk -> third loss; STOP. Pivot to characterization + provisioning law (Method B). Report e9/e10/e11 as an honest negative-result section (deployed compact memory is robust).

predictions.point: BEATS_SOTA per the arithmetic above; the load-bearing mechanism is that Mem0/folk under-protect the non-obviously-fragile zero-floor type (preference on Sonnet) while measurement targets it.
predictions.risk: (1) 10 compact ledger entries under K=4 untested (e8b validated 1 verbatim slot; compact multi-entry may drop lines) -> if ledger integrity breaks, both ledger arms fall. (2) mem0's extractor might naturally keep preferences (they compress well as 'X preference: Y') -> mem0 matches measured allocation by luck -> TIE region. (3) free_text at M=28 may show floors different from the M=12 calibration used in the arithmetic; the leave-one-out calibration inside the run handles this but the predicted margins may shift. (4) n=10 chains, temp=0, no CIs -> directional.
predictions.honest_limits: single model (Sonnet); single regime (M=28,K=4,P=10); faithful-minimal Mem0 (no vector DB; at M=28 the binding constraint is the B-word memory, which is shared by all arms).
